lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I think you're doing better Brendan, I really do. You still remembering about Teresa, and yourself, and that's why you're doing this right?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: That's good. I think that's good, I really do. While you, while you went out, I asked him about, ah if-if he saw any blood on Teresa or Teresa bleeding at all while she was in that house and he said no. Ah, then you came in, we were talking about his injury. Brendan, when Teresa was on the bed, wh-where, what was on the bed, sheets, blankets, what was on the bed?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was she on top of all that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, was there anything else on the bed?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Any plastic or anything like that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Who took th-the leg irons off?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He did. Did she have her socks on? Da-think about it now and try to remember, was she totally naked or did she have her socks on, or anything like that? (pause) And if you can't remember or you don't know, you say that too.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She didn't have no socks on.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: No socks on, oh OK. And the handcuffs, didn't have anything on them, just regular handcuffs?
